summary: Teaches adding and configuring a Loki data source with auth, testing it and querying logs in Explore.

needs.description: A reachable Loki backend (Grafana Cloud Logs URL e.g. https://logs-prod-006.grafana.net, or self-managed/GEL) with credentials: user ID and a token with logs:read.
Logs in Loki queryable with a label selector such as {job="varlogs"}.
Admin rights to add data sources.
Private data source connect agent, only if Loki is self-managed on a private network.

reviewNotes: Test could be satisfied by pointing at the stack own grafanacloud-*-logs Loki endpoint with an access policy token; secret provisioning needed. External-infra need only applies if using self-managed Loki.
